note: Measured from a complete build. Regenerate deliberately with `node scripts/check-web-bundle-budget.mjs --update`, and say why in the commit. Measured contribution 1.3 KiB gzip (350.5 -> 351.8), which crossed a cap the tree was already 0.7 KiB under. The previous baseline was the Phase-3 web-client measurement (319.3 KiB) and had absorbed 9.8% of drift without ever being re-recorded, so this records where the tree actually is rather than granting new room.
